==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I am in a large, futuristic city. Some of the skyscrapers resemble giant food. The city is very colorful overall. The elite class control everything within the city. Everyone is subservient to the elite class. Oddly enough most people seem to be fine with this. I am not in the elite class. I deliver packages in a flying vehicle across the city. The world feels unfamiliar, but I never realize I am dreaming until I wake up.
